title: Periodical Repair and Maintenance of Tillangchang Lighthouse Tower under Port Blair Directorate.
summary: Notice inviting sealed bids for periodical repair and maintenance of the 24 m GI trestle tower at Tillangchang Lighthouse, Tillangchang Island, Nicobar: jungle clearing, repainting the tower and hiring boats for inspection. Issued by the Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Port Blair.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Port Blair

sites.name: Tillangchang Lighthouse, Tillangchang Island, Nicobar
sites.work: Periodical repair and maintenance of trestle tower: jungle clearing, painting, angle replacement

scope.item: Clearing jungle including uprooting rank vegetation, grass, brushwood, trees and saplings of girth up to 30 cm, and removal of rubbish up to 50 m

Synthetic enamel painting (Asian/Berger/Dulux/Nerolac high glossy), two or more coats, on previously painted surface of GI trestle tower (24 m high), including cleaning, primer on worn places, bosun chair/jhulla/scaffolding
Engaging mechanised dinghy with safety boat, one operator and one helper each, for site inspection by officials, including fuel

money.performance_security: 10% of contract value as FDR, valid sixty days beyond completion; refunded 3 months after completion subject to no defects
money.notes: No EMD; Bid Securing Declaration required instead. Rates inclusive of all taxes and GST. Payment on first and final bill for actual measured work.

period.completion: 03 months from date of issue of work order

eligibility: Proof of satisfactory completion of similar works in last 7 years in Central/State Government; similar work means civil works including painting
Bid acceptance letter, undertaking and bid securing declaration
specs: Synthetic enamel paint to IS 2933; approved makes Asian/Berger/Dulux/Nerolac; water proofing compound Pidilite/Dr. Fixit/Fosroc; putty Iroseal or equivalent
Shades: trestle tower Snow White/Brilliant White and Signal Red; automation box and handrail Bus Green; gate and pedestal Black
Scope also mentions replacing trestle tower angles wherever required
Contractor to arrange drinking water from outside site (groundwater tapping in CRZ objectionable) and generator power
